text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, alprazolam 0.5 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Current inventory across three Corvale sites provides 20 to 27 days on hand at present usage rates. Corvale East holds 157 units (25.2 days), Corvale General holds 155.8 units (19.9 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 44 units (26.9 days).

Why (FDA record): The product label for NDC 65862067799 identifies Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3007373532) as the registered manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 1105823 of that plant ended 2019-09-27 and was classified Official Action Indicated (OAI), known to FDA on 2019-12-26. A subsequent inspection (1169446) ended 2022-05-10 and was classified Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI), known to FDA on 2022-08-04.

Our position: Supply is limited but not in shortage per FDA. We should secure a reliable alternate source before inventory falls below 14 days.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify NuCare Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as secondary source; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Par Health USA, LLC, A-S Medication Solutions, and ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. for future bids; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
